CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents was stated.

COD.rationale: Content sets (red/blue) and an origin/status field are explicitly present for the same referent/time, supporting identification, organization and status differentiation.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition was linked to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly bind color-content sets to named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content lists, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

O.rationale: The report explicitly specifies how content is organized/presented (color-to-coordinate set mappings) for named referents and times.
